Refugees, wagons, and foot traffic clog the muddy approach; guards hold the choke while the crowd presses in.

parsed_response.narration: Rain spatters against the soot-dark stone framing Cinderwatch's eastern gate, where frayed banners flutter in the chill wind. The muddy approach is jammed thick with refugees, jostling wagons, and steady foot traffic, all held in a tight choke by the watchful guards. Alongside the muddy line, threadbare watchers and ragged strangers observe more than they openly show, while a well-appointed townhouse overlooks the square, its noble colors a stark contrast to the grim scene beneath. Nearby, a gate serjeant vigilantly manages the crowd, keeping one eye on the notice board that lists new taxes, curfew rules, and a posted warning about a missing patrol. Amid the tension, a tavern runner shouts offers of hot stew and paid rumor near a rain barrel, trying to earn coin from passersby. Ash Compact census delays have tightened the flow through this eastern caravan choke point, adding a sterile pressure to the cacophony of voices and movement.
